NEW CAMPAIGN TRAIL: In the vast majority of cases, states use a winner-take-all method. For instance, if Candiate A defeats Candidate B in a state, worth 20 electoral votes, Candidate A will usually win all 20 votes.
新竞选之路: 绝大多数州实行赢家通吃。例如，某州有20张选举人票，候选人甲击败乙后，通常可以获得该州全部20票。

NEW CAMPAIGN TRAIL: This method tends to concentrate the election into a handful of swing states. It also makes it difficult for third-party candidates to win electoral votes. On the other hand, it is easier for a single candidate to gain an overall majority of the electoral votes.
新竞选之路: 这种制度使竞选集中于少数摇摆州，也让第三党候选人较难获得选举人票；同时，单一候选人更容易取得选举人票的过半多数。

NEW CAMPAIGN TRAIL: Allocate each state's electoral votes proportionally.
新竞选之路: 按照普选票比例分配各州的选举人票。

NEW CAMPAIGN TRAIL: Under this method, all candidates split the electoral votes in a state, in proportion to their popular vote %.
新竞选之路: 各候选人按本州普选得票率分配选举人票。

NEW CAMPAIGN TRAIL: There is still an advantage to winning a state -- the winner of the state will always receive a plurality of electoral votes. For instance, in a state with 4 electoral votes, if Candidate A wins 51% of the vote, they will be awarded 3 electoral votes.
新竞选之路: 赢下一州仍有优势：该州胜者始终获得最多的选举人票。例如，某州有4张选举人票，候选人甲获得51%的普选票时，将获得3张选举人票。

NEW CAMPAIGN TRAIL: Compared to a winner-take-all method, this method aligns the electoral vote more closely with the popular vote. It also makes it easier to third party candidates to increase their electoral vote totals. In some scenarios, this effect is highly significant on the final outcome. Some examples are 1860, 1948, 1968, and 2000.
新竞选之路: 与赢家通吃相比，比例分配让选举人票更接近普选结果，也让第三党更容易获得选举人票。这可能显著改变1860、1948、1968和2000等年份的结果。
